$comment: The one authoritative definition of the graph op protocol shared by the managed IR (TensorSharp.Graph.GraphOp), the GGML managed bridge (TensorSharp.GGML.GgmlGraphOp) and the native bridge (TsgGraphOp in TensorSharp.GGML.Native). Edit this file, then run `dotnet run --project eng/graph-schema` to regenerate GraphOp.g.cs, GgmlGraphOp.g.cs and tsg_graph_ops.g.h; GraphOpSchemaTests fails while a generated file is stale. srcs: operand names in order, a trailing '?' marks an optional operand (all optional ones follow the required ones); an object form {min, max, names} lists a variadic tail. ip / fp: parameter slots in order, 'Name=default' where the executors fall back to a default when the slot is absent; min is how many leading slots every program must carry. Bump version when an op's meaning changes without a structural change (the hash covers codes, names and slot structure, not docs).

ops.name: GetRows
ops.doc: Rows of <c>table</c> at <c>ids</c> (I32): ggml_get_rows.

ops.name: Add
ops.doc: a + b, b repeated over a (ggml_add).

ops.name: Sub
ops.doc: a - b, b repeated over a (ggml_sub).

ops.name: Mul
ops.doc: a * b, b repeated over a (ggml_mul).

ops.name: Div
ops.doc: a / b, b repeated over a (ggml_div).

ops.name: Scale
ops.doc: x * s (ggml_scale).

ops.name: ScaleBias
ops.doc: x * s + b (ggml_scale_bias).

ops.name: RmsNorm
ops.doc: Each row RMS-normed: x / sqrt(mean(x^2) + eps) (ggml_rms_norm).

ops.name: Norm
ops.doc: Each row layer-normed without a gain (ggml_norm).

ops.name: L2Norm
ops.doc: Each row L2-normed: x / max(|x|, eps) (ggml_l2_norm).

ops.name: GroupNorm
ops.doc: ggml_group_norm over <c>groups</c> channel groups.

ops.name: MulMat
ops.doc: weight · x (ggml_mul_mat). Ip: ggml's accumulation precision (0: the backend's default), and 1 where a row block of the weight is read alone (GraphStep.MatMulRows), which need not be a shared product.

ops.name: MulMatId
ops.doc: The stacked experts' products of each row's routes (ggml_mul_mat_id).

ops.name: Silu
ops.doc: x * sigmoid(x) (ggml_silu).

ops.name: Gelu
ops.doc: ggml_gelu's tanh approximation of GELU.

ops.name: GeluQuick
ops.doc: x * sigmoid(1.702 x) (ggml_gelu_quick).

ops.name: Sigmoid
ops.doc: ggml_sigmoid.

ops.name: Softplus
ops.doc: log(1 + exp(x)) (ggml_softplus).

ops.name: Exp
ops.doc: ggml_exp.

ops.name: Neg
ops.doc: ggml_neg.

ops.name: Tanh
ops.doc: ggml_tanh.

ops.name: Relu
ops.doc: ggml_relu.

ops.name: Sqr
ops.doc: x * x (ggml_sqr).

ops.name: Sqrt
ops.doc: ggml_sqrt.

ops.name: SwigluSplit
ops.doc: silu(a) * b (ggml_swiglu_split).

ops.name: GegluSplit
ops.doc: gelu(a) * b (ggml_geglu_split).

ops.name: Reshape
ops.doc: x reshaped to the 1-4 extents of Ip, innermost first (ggml_reshape_Nd).

ops.name: View
ops.doc: A strided view of x (ggml_view_Nd): its rank (1-4), four extents, three byte strides and a byte offset; extents and strides past the rank are ignored.

ops.name: Permute
ops.doc: ggml_permute: source axis i goes to axis Ip[i].

ops.name: Transpose
ops.doc: The first two axes swapped (ggml_transpose).

ops.name: Cont
ops.doc: A contiguous copy (ggml_cont).

ops.name: Cast
ops.doc: x converted to the GraphFormat in Ip (ggml_cast).

ops.name: Cpy
ops.doc: src copied into dst; the result views dst (ggml_cpy).

ops.name: SetRows
ops.doc: src's rows written into dst at rowIds; the result views dst (ggml_set_rows).

ops.name: RopeExt
ops.doc: Rotary embedding of x [d, heads, rows] at the rows' positions (I32 [rows]), with ggml_rope_ext's optional frequency factors (Gemma 4's proportional global RoPE).

ops.name: FlashAttnExt
ops.doc: ggml_flash_attn_ext: q [d, nq, H], k [d, nkv, Hkv], v [dv, nkv, Hkv], an F16 mask [nkv, nq_pad] and per-head sinks (F32 [heads]). Ip: ggml's accumulation precision, the most keys a mask row leaves finite (0: unknown), the rows' kind (<see cref="GraphAttentionRows"/>) and a sliding window's band where the executor reads band masks on the device. Trailing ip a program does not need are omitted, so an op keeps the bytes and signature it had.

ops.name: SoftMaxExt
ops.doc: softmax(x * scale + mask) along rows (ggml_soft_max_ext).

ops.name: Argsort
ops.doc: Each row's argsort (ggml_argsort): Ip 0 ascending, 1 descending.

ops.name: TopK
ops.doc: Each row's K largest values' ids, in descending order. With Ip[1] = 1 a greedy head: each row's id read back as an F32 value, the optional mask's -inf entries suppressed (GreedyHead).

ops.name: SumRows
ops.doc: Each row's sum (ggml_sum_rows).

ops.name: SsmConv
ops.doc: A short causal convolution of the conv window (ggml_ssm_conv).

ops.name: GatedDeltaNet
ops.doc: The gated delta rule's recurrence (ggml_gated_delta_net). Ip: the states kept, the rows the saved inputs hold (with the saved-inputs leaf, srcs[6]: a verify window's outputs alone) and 1 where the decode rows' kernels compute it.

ops.name: Concat
ops.doc: a and b concatenated along axis Ip[0] (ggml_concat).

ops.name: Clamp
ops.doc: x clamped to [min, max] (ggml_clamp).

ops.name: Repeat
ops.doc: x repeated to the shape of the second operand (ggml_repeat).

ops.name: Pad
ops.doc: Zero padding after each axis (ggml_pad).

ops.name: Mean
ops.doc: Each row's mean (ggml_mean).

ops.name: AddId
ops.doc: a + b's rows at ids (ggml_add_id).

ops.name: Argmax
ops.doc: Each row's argmax (ggml_argmax).

ops.name: KvWindow
ops.doc: A [head_dim, length, kv_heads] window of a KV cache, copied where a backend's attention needs it. Ip[7]: the query heads a KV head serves (-1: not read by flash attention).

ops.name: Swiglu
ops.doc: silu(first half) * second half, along ne0 (ggml_swiglu).

ops.name: Geglu
ops.doc: gelu(first half) * second half, along ne0 (ggml_geglu).

ops.name: RopeMulti
ops.doc: Multi-axis rotary embedding (ggml_rope_multi) at a position table [4 * rows], over the rotary sections in Ip[3..6].

ops.name: MoeHostExperts
ops.doc: Routed SwiGLU experts whose weights stay in host memory: srcs x [n, rows], ids (I32 [k, rows]), route weights ([k, rows]), then the stacked gate, up and down experts, and optionally the next offloaded layer's router and gate stack (a hint: an executor may read that layer's predicted experts ahead); Ip: the layer, the activation (0 SwiGLU, 1 GPT-OSS's clamped SwiGLU at Fp alpha and limit, 2 GeGLU, 3 relu(up)^2), a fused gate|up stack, per-route up scales (srcs[6]), the experts' biases (Ip[4] = 1: srcs[6..8] the gate, up and down stacks' F32 [n_ff, E], [n_ff, E], [n, E]). Result [n, rows] = sum over k of w * down(silu(gate x) * up x) for each row's experts. An executor with <see cref="GraphCapabilities.HostExperts"/> pauses the program there (an accelerator tier registered for the gate stack runs the routes it holds); the others do not take it.

ops.name: LightningIndexer
ops.doc: A lightning indexer's scores (ggml_lightning_indexer): srcs q [d, heads, rows], keys [d, 1, n], the heads' weights [heads, rows] and a mask [n, rows] (F16). Result [n, rows] = sum over heads of weight * relu(q_head . key) plus the mask.

ops.name: TopKMask
ops.doc: A top-k selection's attention mask (ggml_top_k_mask): srcs mask [n_kv, rows], picks [n_top, rows] (I32), then, where Ip[0..2] are set, each pick's score [n_pick, rows] (a pick lives while its score is above -inf), the cells of each pick [n_cells, n_pick] (I32; else a pick is a cell) and cells every row keeps [n_extra, rows] (I32). Result [n_kv, rows]: the mask's value at a kept cell, -inf elsewhere; cells out of range are skipped.

ops.name: AllReduce
ops.doc: This rank's partial [n, rows] summed over its tensor-parallel group (every rank gets the total): srcs the partial, which no other node reads. The ranks' programs run in lockstep (see <see cref="IGraphCollective"/>), so every rank reaches its reduce before any rank reads the total.

ops.name: Conv2d
ops.doc: A 2-D convolution with zero padding (ggml_conv_2d): srcs the kernel [KW, KH, IC, OC] (F32 or F16) and x [W, H, IC, N] (F32). Ip: stride0, stride1, padding0, padding1, dilation0, dilation1 (axis 0 is the width). Result [OW, OH, OC, N] (F32), OW = (W + 2 p0 - d0 (KW - 1) - 1) / s0 + 1 (OH alike). With an F16 kernel x is read at F16 (ggml's im2col columns for it), with an F32 kernel at F32.

ops.name: PadReflect1d
ops.doc: Reflect padding along ne0 (ggml_pad_reflect_1d): srcs x (F32, contiguous). Ip: p0 (before), p1 (after), each less than ne0. Result [p0 + ne0 + p1, ne1, ne2, ne3]: column p0 + i is x's column i, column p0 - j (1 <= j <= p0) is x's column j and column p0 + ne0 - 1 + j (1 <= j <= p1) is x's column ne0 - 1 - j (the edge not repeated). Padding of two axes is two passes, the second over a transpose.

ops.name: DepthwiseConv2d
ops.doc: A depthwise 2-D convolution over rows of channels (ggml_conv_2d_dw_direct's arithmetic, in the layout the IR's token rows already have): srcs x [C, W, H, N] (channels innermost) and the kernel [KW, KH, 1, C] (ggml's depthwise kernel layout, F32). Ip: stride0, stride1, pad0, pad1, dilation0, dilation1 (index 0 along W, 1 along H; zero padding on both sides). Result [C, OW, OH, N] with OW = (W + 2 pad0 - dilation0 (KW - 1) - 1) / stride0 + 1 (OH likewise): output (c, ow, oh, n) is the sum over the kernel taps, ky outer and kx inner, of kernel[kx, ky, 0, c] * x[c, ow stride0 + kx dilation0 - pad0, oh stride1 + ky dilation1 - pad1, n], taps that fall outside x contributing nothing.

ops.name: GeluErf
ops.doc: GELU in its exact form, 0.5 x (1 + erf(x / sqrt 2)) (ggml_gelu_erf; <see cref="Gelu"/> is ggml_gelu's tanh approximation). Executors without an erf kernel evaluate erf with Abramowitz and Stegun's 7.1.26 (|error| below 1.5e-7), as ggml-metal does.

ops.name: Log
ops.doc: The natural logarithm (ggml_log).

ops.name: CumSum
ops.doc: The running sum along ne0 (ggml_cumsum): y[i] = x[0] + ... + x[i] in each row.

ops.name: SsmScan
ops.doc: Mamba-2's selective scan (ggml_ssm_scan with a scalar decay per head): srcs the states s [d_state, head_dim, n_head, n_seqs], x [head_dim, n_head, n_t, n_seqs], dt [n_head, n_t, n_seqs] (before its softplus), A [1, n_head], B and C [d_state, n_group, n_t, n_seqs] (head h reads group h / (n_head / n_group)) and ids (I32 [n_seqs]: the state slot each sequence starts from). Ip[0]: K, the states kept (1 or more). Per head and token: dt' = softplus(dt), state = state * exp(dt' A) + B (x dt'), y = state . C. Result, F32 and one-dimensional: y [head_dim, n_head, n_t, n_seqs], then K state slots [d_state, head_dim, n_head, n_seqs] each: slot 0 the state after the last token, slot j the state j tokens before it (a slot older than the tokens is left as it was). The D skip and the gate are the family's ops.

ops.name: SwigluOai
ops.doc: GPT-OSS's clamped SwiGLU (ggml_swiglu_oai): srcs gate and up, of one shape. Fp: alpha, limit. With g = min(gate, limit) and u = clamp(up, -limit, limit), the result is g * sigmoid(alpha * g) * (u + 1).
